name: Ríu, ríu, chíu
pages: Wikimedia Commons, "Ríu Ríu Chíu.mid" (setting by Peter Gerloff, CC0)
about: The villancico printed in the Cancionero de Upsala (Venice, 1556), in D minor: the setting's lower and upper voices each sing their three phrases, here one after the other; quarter notes as beats.
